<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; text-align: right; margin: 0pt 0"><B>Exhibit 10.4</B></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: center; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">Certain schedules and exhibits to this agreement have been omitted pursuant to Item 601(a)(5) of Regulation S-K. A copy of any omitted
schedule and/or exhibit will be furnished supplementally to the SEC upon request.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="text-align: center; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt">[***] Certain information in this document has been excluded pursuant to Regulation S-K, Item 601(a)(6). Such excluded information is
not material and is the type that the registrant treats as private or confidential.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><IMG SRC="tm2528763d6_ex10-4img001.jpg" ALT="">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">S&amp;P Global</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">55 Water Street</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">New York, New York 10041</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">[***]</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">July 28, 2025</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Bill Eager</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">[***]</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">Dear Bill,</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Congratulations on your new position as President,
S&amp;P Global Mobility! You will be starting in your position on or around August 15, 2025 (&ldquo;Start Date&rdquo;), with a principal
location of Virginia, or such other date or location as may be agreed to by the Company in writing. Where applicable, the Company will
recognize your continuous years of service to the wholly-owned subsidiary. This offer is contingent on beginning your employment as indicated
above.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Your payroll employer entity is S&amp;P Global,
Inc. (the &ldquo;Company&rdquo;) and you will be paid $650,000 USD based on an annualized base salary, less lawful deductions. This position
is classified as exempt under the Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA) and therefore is not eligible for overtime pay.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">You will be eligible to participate in the applicable
annual bonus plan (&ldquo;Bonus Plan&rdquo;) with a target incentive opportunity of $900,000 USD. Actual payment under the Bonus Plan,
if any, will be based on the degree of achievement of the established company and/or division objective(s) and your individual performance
and contribution, as determined in the Company&rsquo;s discretion and as approved by the CLDC. For the 2025 Bonus Plan year, your award
for the performance year will be a blended rate based on the number of days you have been employed in Carfax and in the Company with
your final payment amount determined in the Company&rsquo;s discretion, as approved by the CLDC. Awards may be less than the communicated
target and are subject to your People Leader&rsquo;s assessment of your performance. Please note that your target opportunity and eligibility
are not commitments to pay any award, as all payments under the Bonus Plan are discretionary. Target opportunities are subject to change
by the Company in its discretion from year to year. In order to be eligible for each annual Bonus Plan, you must be employed on or before
September 30th of the Bonus Plan year. Further, to receive a payment, you must be an employee in good standing and be employed by S&amp;P
Global, or any of its business units, on the Bonus Plan payout date<I>.</I></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">You will also be eligible to participate in the
S&amp;P Global Long-Term Stock Incentive Program. Under this Program, for 2026, you will be eligible to receive a long-term incentive
grant that, if approved by management and granted, will be a target value of $2,950,000 USD. Any such grant will be subject in all respects
(including, but not limited to, with respect to vesting) to the terms and conditions of the S&amp;P Global Long-Term Stock Incentive
Program under the S&amp;P Global Inc. 2019 Stock Incentive Plan, as applicable, and the associated award agreement that you receive at
the time of grant. In addition, you may also be eligible to receive future long-term incentive grants, as determined by the CLDC in its
sole discretion, subject to the terms and conditions of the then-applicable S&amp;P Global Long-Term Stock Incentive Program. For the
avoidance of doubt, any long-term incentive grant you receive in 2026 is not a guarantee that the same or a similar award will be made
in future years, and there is no assurance that any future long-term incentive awards will be made.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<!-- Field: Page; Sequence: 1 -->
    <DIV STYLE="margin-top: 12pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; border-bottom: Black 1pt solid"><P STYLE="margin: 0pt">&nbsp;</P></DIV>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><IMG SRC="tm2528763d6_ex10-4img001.jpg" ALT="">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Following your start date, and subject to the
conditions set forth below, you will receive a one-time Restricted Stock Unit Award under the S&amp;P Global Inc. 2019 Stock Incentive
Plan equal to $2,000,000 USD which dollar amount shall be converted into a number of share of S&amp;P Global Inc. common stock (Ticker:
SPGI) using the ten day average closing price of the Company&rsquo;s common stock preceding the grant date. This award will cliff vest
in its entirety on the third anniversary of the award grant date and will be subject in all respects (including, but not limited to,
with respect to vesting) to the terms and conditions of the applicable Stock Incentive Plan and the associated award agreement that you
receive at the time of grant. Dividend equivalents will be accrued during the award period and will be paid in cash, along with vested
shares. The Restricted Stock Unit Award will be subject to the approval of CLDC prior to the grant of such Award and the terms and conditions
set forth in the 2019 Stock Incentive Plan and the associated award agreement that you receive at the time of grant.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">The Company reserves the right to cancel or delay
payment of awards pending the outcome of disciplinary procedures or investigations into matters that could be considered grounds for
termination of employment or pay recovery as stated by the Pay Recovery Policy. Both short term and long-term performance awards are
subject to claw back (recovery, including by means of repayment to the Company) during the relevant performance or time-based vesting
period for the award, plus the 24-month period following the end of the relevant performance or time-based vesting period or discretionary
award date. While your affirmation is not required for the Policy to apply, your acceptance of any award, grant or payment that is subject
to the Pay Recovery Policy will constitute your consent to and acceptance of the application of such Policy.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Effective with your employment, you shall participate
in the Senior Executive Severance Plan, which currently provides 12 months&rsquo; salary for participants with less than 24 months of
service and 18 months&rsquo; salary for participants with 24 months or more of service in the event of a &ldquo;Qualified Termination
of Employment,&rdquo; as defined in the Plan. For the avoidance of doubt, your continuous years of service to the Company do not count
towards your participation in the Senior Executive Severance Plan.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Effective with your employment, you will participate
in the Management Supplemental Death and Disability Plan, which provides for pre-retirement death benefits equal to two times your annual
base salary. Should you become disabled while employed by S&amp;P Global, you shall be provided with a monthly disability income benefit,
as defined under the Plan and reduced by certain plan-specified offsets.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">You will be eligible to receive all benefits
routinely made available to all S&amp;P Global employees with the same employer entity and at comparable levels. Also, you are
subject to all eligible policies of S&amp;P Global. You must enroll in all benefit plans within your first thirty days, and benefit
coverage is retroactive to your Start Date. Please <U>click here</U> to review information regarding the benefits available to
employees of S&amp;P Global.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">In addition to the standard benefits, you will
be entitled to the following perquisites, which are reviewed periodically and subject to change:</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="width: 100%; font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

<TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD></TD><TD><FONT STYLE="font-family: Symbol; font-size: 10pt">&middot;</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify">Tax counseling and return preparation</TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">S&amp;P Global has a flexible paid time off program (called &ldquo;Recharge&rdquo;).
Additional information about our Recharge program can be found <U>here</U>.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Please note that your offer of employment with
S&amp;P Global is contingent upon the successful completion of a background investigation, which will be administered by an independent
third-party vendor, Sterling Talent Solutions. The investigation will include employment and education verification, as well as a criminal
history and credit check.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">All employees are required to adhere to the Company&rsquo;s
Code of Business Ethics (the &ldquo;<U>COBE</U>&rdquo;) and Securities Disclosure Policy throughout their employment, including any notice
periods (whether worked, not worked or &ldquo;garden leave&rdquo;).&#8239; The purpose of the Code of Business Ethics and the Securities
Disclosure Policy is to establish guidelines reasonably designed to identify and prevent recipients form breaching any applicable fiduciary
duties and to deal with other situations that may pose a conflict of interest or the appearance of a conflict of interest.&#8239;In addition,
there are divisions of S&amp;P Global that require affirmations to a Code of Conduct, Code of Business Ethics and/or a Securities Disclosure
Policy. The purpose of the Code of Conduct is to reflect the high&minus;level principles that govern the conduct of the Company&rsquo;s
Credit Rating Activities. Failure to comply with Company policies, including the Code and Securities Disclosure Policy, may result in
disciplinary action up to and including termination of employment. &#8239;All violations or potential violations of the Code of which
you become aware, should be reported promptly to the People Team. &#8239;Each year, you will be required to sign or otherwise indicate
your assent to an Affirmation Statement to confirm that you have reviewed the Code and understand your continuing obligation to comply
with its terms.&#8239; Periodic certifications relating to the Securities Disclosure Policy are also required. &#8239;Please note that
the Securities Disclosure Policy includes requirements that may extend to an employee&rsquo;s immediate family (as defined in the policy),
and that for some positions the applicable policies may impact your ability to maintain and conduct trades of certain holdings.&#8239;
To the extent that the Code and Securities Disclosure Policy, or compliance therewith, would be inconsistent with applicable law, applicable
law will govern. Any questions relating to the &ldquo;Codes&rdquo; or the Securities Disclosure Policy should be directed to [***].</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">By accepting this letter of offer, you acknowledge
that you are aware that your personal data will be handled in accordance with the S&amp;P Global <U>Employee Privacy Policy (Applicable
to U.S., India and Pakistan</U>). This policy means that your data may be collected, transferred, disclosed, stored or otherwise processed
in S&amp;P Global and its affiliates&rsquo; systems, as well as the systems of service providers, that may be located in a jurisdiction
which is different to your work location and where the data privacy laws may be different to the laws in your work location. Please take
a moment to review the Policy before accepting this letter of offer. S&amp;P Global updates its policies from time to time. If you have
any questions about the applicable Policy now or in the future, please contact [***].</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">This letter is not an offer of a contract of
employment. It is the Company&rsquo;s policy that all employment is &ldquo;at-will.&rdquo; This means either the employee or the Company may
terminate employment for any reason at any time. No change in the &ldquo;at-will&rdquo; employment relationship is valid unless it is contained
in a written agreement signed by <U>an authorized officer</U> of S&amp;P Global.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">Federal law requires U.S. employers to verify
that all new employees are eligible to work in the United States pursuant to the Immigration Reform and Control Act of 1986. As a condition
of your employment, as set forth by the Act, you will be required to provide proof of identity and employment authorization within three
(3) days of your Hire Date by completing the Form I-9. Shortly after offer acceptance, you will receive an email communication from the
S&amp;P Global Onboarding team with instructions on how to complete your pre-boarding tasks including updating personal information and
I-9 requirements.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">If you require immigration sponsorship by S&amp;P
Global now or in the future, in order to accept or continue employment with us, we reserve the right to determine whether to pursue a
nonimmigrant case on your behalf. Further, you should be aware that there is no guarantee that the government will approve any such case
that we do file on your behalf. By accepting this offer, you represent that you are not aware of any circumstances that would make you
ineligible for nonimmigrant status. Please note also that by sponsoring you for nonimmigrant work status, S&amp;P Global is not committing
to sponsoring you for permanent resident status.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">You acknowledge and agree that terms and conditions
set forth in <B>Attachment A (Agreement for the Protection of Company Interests) </B>hereto are hereby incorporated into, and are part
of, the terms and conditions of this offer letter. You acknowledge that you have reviewed and understand the terms of the Agreement for
the Protection of Company Interests, and that by accepting this offer letter you are accepting the terms in Attachment A, including the
non-solicitation of employees, confidentiality and ownership of information provisions.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">You will receive a notification requesting you
to provide an e-signature to accept this offer. You must complete this step, in order to move forward in the hiring process.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">We are looking forward to you joining our team!
In the meantime, if you have any questions, please do not hesitate to call me.</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"></P>
